title: Remote Work Policy
content: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Employees must be available during their team's core collaboration hours. Remote work does not change data handling responsibilities.

title: Vacation Policy
content: Full-time employees receive twenty paid vacation days each calendar year. Vacation requests should be submitted at least two weeks before planned leave.

title: Expense Policy
content: Employees must submit itemized receipts for business expenses of twenty-five dollars or more. Expense reports are due within thirty days of the purchase.

title: Travel Policy
content: Business travel must be booked through the approved travel portal. Airfare should be economy class unless a written executive exception is approved.

title: Password Policy
content: Passwords must contain at least fourteen characters and use a password manager. Employees must not share passwords or reuse corporate passwords on personal services.

title: Acceptable Use Policy
content: Company systems are for authorized business use. Employees must not install unapproved software or use company devices for unlawful activity.

title: Incident Response Guide
content: Suspected security incidents must be reported immediately to the security operations team using the incident hotline or portal. Preserve relevant evidence and do not investigate independently.

title: Data Classification Policy
content: Information is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted. Restricted information requires the highest handling safeguards and limited access.

title: Benefits Guide
content: Eligible employees may enroll in health coverage within thirty days of their start date or a qualifying life event. The company contributes toward monthly premiums.

title: IT Support Guide
content: IT support is available through the service desk portal. Critical outages may be reported by telephone twenty-four hours a day.

title: Procurement Guide
content: Purchases above five thousand dollars require procurement review before a vendor commitment is made. Use approved suppliers whenever available.

title: Facilities Policy
content: Employees must wear their building badge while onsite and must not allow visitors to enter secured areas without escort.

title: Vendor Management Policy
content: New vendors handling company information require a risk review before contract signature. Vendor owners must document the business purpose and data involved.

title: Software Development Policy
content: Production code changes require peer review and automated tests before merge. Emergency changes require retrospective review on the next business day.

title: Employee Handbook
content: Employees are expected to act respectfully and follow company policies. Questions about workplace conduct should be directed to Human Resources.

title: Information Security Policy
content: Company laptops must use full-disk encryption and automatic screen lock. Report lost or stolen devices to IT security immediately.

title: Meeting Practices Guide
content: Meeting organizers should publish an agenda in advance and record action items with owners. Recurring meetings should be reviewed quarterly for usefulness.

title: Learning and Development Guide
content: Employees receive an annual learning budget of one thousand dollars for approved professional development. Manager approval is required before enrollment.

title: Records Retention Policy
content: Business records must be retained according to the records schedule. Legal hold notices suspend ordinary deletion for relevant records.

title: Code of Conduct
content: Employees may report suspected misconduct to Human Resources, their manager, or the confidential ethics channel. Retaliation for good-faith reporting is prohibited.
